input.sha256_scope: No input pixels or files are committed. The upstream configs live in the read-only checkout, which a clean checkout of this repository does not have; this record is the reconciliation of them and its own digest is this value. A test compares the record against the checkout when it is present.
input.provenance: Generated by reading the pinned checkout's configs directory.

upstream.capture_method: Each config was parsed and classified by its declared Architecture.algorithm and PostProcess.name. Nothing was written to the checkout.

limitations: The checkout holds 139 configs, not the ~155 the roadmap estimated. The count is recorded as measured.
Classification is by declared algorithm and postprocess name. It says which upstream component a config needs, not whether this port would reproduce that config's results.
`Out of scope` is deliberately unassigned: the roadmap reserves it for a user-approved exclusion, and this reconciliation records evidence rather than making that decision.
The checkout-comparison test is skipped when the read-only symlink is absent, so the suite still runs in a clean checkout.
